title: 第231章  会堂挑衅
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“不是他主动携带，是提前很久被种进体内。”

那人吓得脸色惨白。

“我……我不知道……我真的不知道……”

沈冰心道：“别动。”

她迅速落针，控制血蛊扩散。

可那滴血已经落地。

地砖黑纹亮起后，一道细线迅速向擂台方向蔓延。

宋青山一步踏出，至阳真气落下，硬生生烧断黑线。

但黑线断裂前，仍有一缕气机钻入地下。

井心第二次回响。

这一次，比刚才更清晰。

会场中少数武者开始躁动。

“怎么回事？”

“地底什么声音？”

“不是普通茶会吗？”

江怀远立刻出面压住场面。

“有人突发旧疾，诸位留在原位，不要走动！”

霍家武者也迅速站位。

陆沉冷眼扫过金石门区域。

“所有弟子，不得离位。”

然而，躁动已经出现。

这正是黑先生要的。

不是大乱。

而是第一丝不安。

第一滴血，第一声疑问，第一缕恐惧。

众生锁不是靠一次爆发完成。

它靠人心一点点松动。

宋青山看向沈冰心。

沈冰心已经取出一只小银盒，将服务人员体内血蛊逼出。

那血蛊细如发丝，通体黑红，落入银盒后仍在疯狂扭动。

“能救。”

沈冰心道。

宋青山点头，目光却看向会场四周。

既然有第一个血点，就可能有第二个。

江明珠也明白了。

她脸色微白，却没有动。

黑虎压低声音：“江小姐，要不要退？”

江明珠摇头。

“不能退。”

她若一退，魂门替位就空了。

而且黑先生可能正在等她动。

她现在不是江家大小姐。

她是藏着真魂玉的暗灯。

暗灯不能乱晃。

金石门区域。

金无烈坐在椅上，脸色越来越难看。

第一滴血落地后，他右臂虫纹骤然发热。

虽然反封仍在，但那股来自井下的牵引开始增强。

他死死咬牙，不让自己露出异样。

陆沉走到他身边，低声道：“感觉到了？”

金无烈额头冷汗滚落。

“它在叫我。”

“说什么？”

金无烈喉咙发紧。

“敲。”

第(1/3)页
content_en:
Page (1/3)

"He didn't carry it actively, it was implanted into his body long in advance."

The man turned pale with fear.

"I...I don't know...I really don't know..."

Shen Bingxin said: "Don't move."

She quickly dropped the needle to control the spread of blood poison.

But the drop of blood has already fallen to the ground.

After the black lines on the floor tiles lit up, a thin line quickly spread towards the ring.

Song Qingshan took a step forward, and Zhiyang Zhenqi fell, forcibly burning the black thread.

But before the black line broke, there was still a wisp of air drilling into the ground.

The center of the well echoed for the second time.

This time, it was clearer than before.

A few warriors in the venue began to become restless.

"What's going on?"

"What's the sound underground?"

"Isn't it an ordinary tea party?"

Jiang Huaiyuan immediately stepped in to suppress the situation.

"Someone has an old illness. Please stay where you are and don't move around!"

The Huo family warriors also quickly took up their positions.

Lu Chen glanced coldly at the Jinshimen area.

"All disciples must not leave their positions."

Yet restlessness has set in.

This is exactly what Mr. Black wants.

Not a big mess.

But the first hint of uneasiness.

The first drop of blood, the first question, the first fear.

The lock of sentient beings is not accomplished in one burst.

It relies on people's hearts to loosen little by little.

Song Qingshan looked at Shen Bingxin.

Shen Bingxin had already taken out a small silver box and forced the blood poison out of the service staff's body.

The blood Gu was as thin as a hair, all black and red, and was still twisting wildly after falling into the silver box.

"It can be saved."

Shen Bingxin said.

Song Qingshan nodded, but looked around the venue.

Since there is a first blood point, there may be a second one.

Jiang Mingzhu also understood.

Her face turned pale, but she didn't move.

Heihu lowered his voice: "Miss Jiang, do you want to retreat?"

Jiang Mingzhu shook his head.

"Can't retreat."

If she retreats, the soul gate's replacement will be vacant.

And Mr. Black might be waiting for her to make a move.

She is no longer the eldest daughter of the Jiang family.

She is the dark lamp hiding the true soul jade.

Dark lights cannot be left hanging around.

Jinshimen area.

Jin Wulie sat on the chair, his expression getting increasingly ugly.

After the first drop of blood fell to the ground, the insect marks on his right arm suddenly became hot.

Although the counter-blocking is still there, the pull from underground is beginning to increase.

He gritted his teeth to prevent himself from appearing strange.

Lu Chen walked to him and whispered, "Do you feel it?"

Cold sweat rolled down Jin Wulie's forehead.

"It's calling me."

"What did you say?"

Jin Wulie's throat tightened.

"Knock."
